module_summary: AXI4-to-AXI-lite bridge: skid-buffered AXI bursts are split into single-beat AXI-lite transactions by per-channel beat counters and address generators, with ID/length FIFOs and return counters merging responses back into bursts.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: AXI4 write burst request valid entering the AW skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: AXI4 read burst request valid entering the AR skid buffer

anchors.name: axi_awlen
anchors.why: Remaining write beats; splits burst into AXI-lite writes and ends AWVALID

anchors.name: axi_arlen
anchors.why: Remaining read beats; splits burst into AXI-lite reads and ends ARVALID

anchors.name: axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Current write beat address, advanced by burst address calculator, drives M_AXI_AWADDR

anchors.name: axi_araddr
anchors.why: Current read beat address, advanced by burst address calculator, drives M_AXI_ARADDR

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite write address valid held across all beats of a burst

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite read address valid held across all beats of a burst

anchors.name: s_axi_wready
anchors.why: Write-data phase open from AW accept until WLAST; gates W pass-through

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Write beat data passed through skid buffers to M_AXI_WDATA

anchors.name: bcounts
anchors.why: Outstanding AXI-lite write responses of current burst; decides single BVALID per burst

anchors.name: rcounts
anchors.why: Remaining read beats of current burst; determines RLAST and RID update

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: One merged write response per AXI burst

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: AXI4 read data beat valid returned from AXI-lite reads

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Read beat data registered from AXI-lite read response

anchors.name: skids_awready
anchors.why: Accepts new write burst when previous done, FIFO not full and W phase closed

anchors.name: skids_arready
anchors.why: Accepts new read burst when previous issued and ID FIFO not full

anchors.name: read_from_wrfifo
anchors.why: Pops next write burst ID/length into response counter

anchors.name: read_from_rdfifo
anchors.why: Pops next read burst ID/length into return counter

anchors.name: wfifo_full
anchors.why: Write ID FIFO full; stalls write burst acceptance

anchors.name: rfifo_full
anchors.why: Read ID FIFO full; stalls read burst acceptance

anchors.name: wfifo_empty
anchors.why: No pending write bursts; gates B response acceptance

anchors.name: axi_bresp
anchors.why: Accumulated worst-case write response across burst beats

anchors.name: axi_bid
anchors.why: Write response ID driven to S_AXI_BID

anchors.name: s_axi_rid
anchors.why: Read response ID per burst driven to S_AXI_RID

anchors.name: s_axi_rlast
anchors.why: Marks final beat of reconstructed read burst

anchors.name: axi_blen
anchors.why: Write burst length latched for address wrap calculation

anchors.name: axi_rlen
anchors.why: Read burst length latched for address wrap calculation

anchors.name: skidm_rvalid
anchors.why: Buffered AXI-lite read response valid driving read return

anchors.name: skidm_bvalid
anchors.why: Buffered AXI-lite write response valid driving response merging

anchors.name: skidm_bready
anchors.why: Accepts AXI-lite write responses while a burst is pending

groups.name: Write burst splitter
groups.description: Converts AXI4 write bursts into per-beat AXI-lite AW/W transactions

groups.name: Write response merger
groups.description: ID/length FIFO and counter collapse per-beat B responses into one burst response

groups.name: Read burst splitter
groups.description: Converts AXI4 read bursts into per-beat AXI-lite AR transactions

groups.name: Read return path
groups.description: Rebuilds AXI4 read bursts with RID and RLAST from AXI-lite read responses
